papers.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
limitations: Generation/reconstruction metrics do not evaluate watermark survival. Official SD2 metadata endpoint was inaccessible; no new SD2 revision or gate status is invented.

papers.title: SDXL: Improving Latent Diffusion Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
limitations: Reconstruction at256 does not predict1024 survival. From-scratch training is an author statement, not independent initialization forensics.

papers.title: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
limitations: SD3Medium noncommercial research terms; SD3.5 Community terms differ. Both API snapshots auto-gated. Public text does not authorize gated weights.

papers.title: Kandinsky: an Improved Text-to-Image Synthesis with Image Prior and Latent Diffusion
limitations: KD2.2 native resolution lower than1024; KD3 better1024 proposal. Fix quantization mode explicitly. Independence conclusion does not extend toKandinsky5.

papers.title: Sana: Efficient High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Linear Diffusion Transformers
limitations: Apache ungated packages; upstreamGemma terms/access remain separate. Packaged weights do not erase upstream terms. Optimized headlines do not establish frozen-stack24GB throughput.

papers.title: PixArt-Σ : Weak-to-Strong Training of Diffusion Transformer for 4K Text-to-Image Generation
limitations: Ungated OpenRAIL++ packages, not Apache/MIT permissiveness. Private evaluation/evaluator differences prevent direct score ranking.

papers.title: Playground v2.5: Three Insights towards Enhancing Aesthetic Quality in Text-to-Image Generation
limitations: Custom Playground Community license, ungated. AdvertisedVAE hash is metadata evidence, not locally verified weights.

papers.title: Hunyuan-DiT : A Powerful Multi-Resolution Diffusion Transformer with Fine-Grained Chinese Understanding
limitations: Tencent custom terms, ungated hub; availability is not permissiveness. Native strength wrapper not verified.

papers.title: Qwen-Image Technical Report
limitations: Qwen-Image/2512 are Apache and ungated. Qwen2.1 uses ungated Qwen Research terms, not Apache. The original paper cannot establish successor initialization.

papers.title: Z-Image: An Efficient Image Generation Foundation Model with Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer
limitations: Apache2 and ungated model package. Published object hashes are metadata evidence; no weights or outcomes were generated.

papers.title: Lumina-Image 2.0: A Unified and Efficient Image Generative Framework
limitations: Apache ungated package; upstream Gemma license/access remain separate dependencies. No native strength interface is assumed.

papers.title: HiDream-I1: A High-Efficient Image Generative Foundation Model with Sparse Diffusion Transformer
limitations: MIT ungated model packages. I1 external Llama3.1 is gated. O1 optional Gemma prompt refiner is gated; plain inference loads the local bundled model/processor, not a required external text encoder. No runtime validation.

papers.title: OmniGen: Unified Image Generation
limitations: MIT ungated model. Resource table uses official custom code; current Diffusers may differ, so reported seconds cannot be transferred blindly.

papers.title: Würstchen: An Efficient Architecture for Large-Scale Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
limitations: Ungated custom noncommercial model license. Successor weights and stages prevent direct reuse of paper timing or scores.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
limitations: Apache2 model and permissive diffusion code. An adapter would be new scientific work;256 feasibility does not establish1024 feasibility.

papers.title: Lens: Rethinking Training Efficiency for Foundational Text-to-Image Models
limitations: Code MIT. Actual model revision/license unverified at inaccessible endpoint. GPU-specific quantization undermines a blanket small-VRAM claim.

papers.title: PixelGen: Pixel Diffusion Beats Latent Diffusion with Perceptual Loss
limitations: Official HF weights Apache2 and ungated. Repository tree lacks LICENSE; do not infer code permission from weight terms. Community Diffusers mirror is not official support.

papers.title: Advanced Pixel Diffusion Model with Guided Sparse Global Refinement
limitations: Ungated but empty HF repository; license/code/weights unavailable rather than gated.

papers.title: Deep Compression Autoencoder for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Models
limitations: No full diffusion result can be inferred from encoder-only reconstruction quality.

papers.title: SANA-Sprint: One-Step Diffusion with Continuous-Time Consistency Distillation
limitations: Distilled speed claims do not justify assuming strength labels have the same meaning as DDIM.

papers.title: Wan : Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video Generative Models
limitations: Counted under Qwen family for the conservative floor, not as an extra family just for AE reuse.

papers.title: Kandinsky 3.0 Technical Report
limitations: A larger MoVQ model is not automatically independent of earlier MoVQ training; count the family once.

papers.title: Kandinsky 5.0: A Family of Foundation Models for Image and Video Generation
limitations: Paper inspected V2, but exact image checkpoint revision/license/gate not resolved in this sweep. Treat those model-release fields unavailable, not inferred from old Apache Kandinsky.

papers.title: Qwen-Image-VAE-2.0 Technical Report
limitations: Supplement only, not an additional model family in the floor.

papers.title: HiDream-O1-Image: A Natively Unified Image Generative Foundation Model with Pixel-level Unified Transformer
limitations: MIT code/models, HF ungated. Plain inference uses bundled local weights/tokenizer/processor; optional Gemma4-31B prompt agent requires gate acceptance, optional API can cost money. Neither optional reasoner is required for plain generation or authorized here. PyTorch≥2.10/Transformers4.57.1 and optional FlashAttention differ from frozen stack.
